rules: Martial faction populations are conserved exact people represented by persistent Person Lite or Full Character records; aggregate civilians and ordinary government soldiers remain separate.
Every persistent person on a martial-faction roster is a faction member; membership grade is rank only and work is represented by separate rotating duties.
Faction prestige/scale labels are derived presentation only from population, capability, assets, buildings, reputation and influence. There is no authoritative institution tier field.
New factions appear only by lawful founding, split, merger, transformation or relocation. No periodic narrator faction spawning.
Sect branches are not modeled. Growth uses independent factions, additional facilities at one faction, or new separately founded organizations with conserved people/assets.
